dialogues.speaker: Liliuo
dialogues.text: I lost to you, just like everyone expected. At this rate, you've probably won so many trophies that not even a Long-Necked Rhino could carry them all...

choices.text: I'd like to go over the puzzle challenge one more time.

response.speaker: Liliuo
response.text: Sure. It'll be a good refresher for me, too.

response.speaker: Liliuo
response.text: It's just too cold here. Even someone from the Masters of the Night-Wind like me can barely take it. I'll probably stay for another two weeks at most.

response.speaker: Liliuo
response.text: Once I'm back home, I'm going to tell Rilai and Sappho all about the interesting things I've seen here.

response.speaker: Liliuo
response.text: Oh, and that incredible bartender's creations... I wonder if she does takeout?

response.speaker: Liliuo
response.text: Oh, right! I'm also planning to bring Grandma and Kachina the most expensive desserts in Snezhnaya. And I'll be sure to tell them all about your unbelievable performance here, too.

response.speaker: Liliuo
response.text: Of course, if you'd rather keep a low profile, or tell them yourself... I won't say a word.

choices.text: Not quite. I'll count them when I get back.

response.speaker: Liliuo
response.text: Then be sure to let me know the next time we meet!
